summary: MacroGenics (MGNX) filed an 8-K regarding a First Amendment to its June 2025 Royalty Purchase Agreement with an affiliate of Sagard Healthcare Partners. The amendment grants MacroGenics an additional $60M cash payment, increasing the aggregate purchase price to $130M, in exchange for revised royalty caps on ZYNYZ (retifanlimab) net sales: Sagard receives royalties until 1.70x of aggregate price by Sep 2032 or 2.0x thereafter, after which rights revert to MacroGenics. MacroGenics can earn up to $20M milestone on 2026 sales thresholds. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. This is a financing arrangement, not a special situation, so category is None.
